name: Proxy
summary: Provides a surrogate or placeholder for another object in order to control access to it.

reference.author: Erich Gamma, Richard Helm, Ralph Johnson, John Vlissides

roles.name: Subject
roles.summary: Declares the interface shared by the real object and its proxy, so that they are interchangeable.

roles.name: RealSubject
roles.summary: The object the proxy stands for, and which does the real work.

roles.name: Proxy
roles.summary: Controls access to the real subject, and may be responsible for creating it.
